newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Marin County, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Marin County, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to section 53692 of the California Government Code, that the Board of Supervisors of Marin County, California intends to offer for public sale on Tuesday,

at the hour of 10:30 a.m., California time (or at such later date as shall be established by the Administrator of the County and communicated through Munifacts News Service and Bloomberg's Financial News Wire not less than 24 hours prior to the time bids are to be received), at the office of Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., One Market Plaza, 1100 Steuart Street Tower, San Francisco, California 94105, $50,000,000 principal amount of notes of the County of Marin, California designated the County of Marin,
California, 1997-98 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes'' (the Notes''
), and if no le ble bid is

received on June 3, 1997, at the time and place specified, Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc. will accept bids for the purchase of the Notes at the same time and place specified on such other date as shall be communicated by Munifacts News Service and Bloomberg's Financial News Wire. NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Notes will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale of the Notes, and copies of the Official Notice of Sale and of a Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Notes will be furnished upon request Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., One Market Plaza, 1100 Steuart Street Tower, San Francisco, California 94105, (415) 979-0300, Attention: Lisa O'Brien.
